fields.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Ashe's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{critical damage|0 to 100|0 to 100|critScaling=true}} of the {{as|attack's damage}}. {{tip|critical strike|Critical strikes}} do not deal any additional damage.
fields.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Frost Shot:}} '''Ashe's''' basic attacks and ability hits apply ''Frost'' to enemies for 2 seconds, which {{tip|slow|slows}} them by {{pplevel|key=%|20 to 30}} for the duration.
fields.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Critical Slow:}} '''Ashe's''' {{tip|critical strike|critical strikes}} double ''Frost's'' slow strength to {{pplevel|key=%|20*2 to 30*2}}, decaying over the first second of the duration to its normal strength.
fields.notes:
* '''Ashe's''' critical strikes are still considered {{as|critical strike damage}} and thus will be reduced by {{iis|Randuin's Omen}} {{nie|Resilience}}.
* {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} will not deal additional damage on {{tip|critical strike|critical strikes}}.
* {{ri|Cheap Shot}} will trigger on a subsequent basic attack even when the target is no longer slowed.{{bug|2}}
